subject: [PATCH 35/60] mm/mempolicy: keep private nodes out of migrate_pages() destinations

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue with private nodes being included in migrate_pages() destinations, which can lead to allocation failures. Proposed a fix by excluding private nodes from the destination mask.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: The patch series addresses issues in the mm/mempolicy code, specifically focusing on private nodes and their interaction with migrate_pages(). The goal is to prevent allocation failures when migrating pages to private nodes.
